hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.tex|*.bib) cd "${CLAUDE_CWD}" && out=$(python3 validate_latex.py "$(dirname "$f")" 2>&1); jq -n --arg ctx "$out" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PostToolUse", additionalContext:$ctx}}' ;; esac; }
hooks.statusMessage: Compiling LaTeX to check for errors...
